model_output:
```sql
WITH golf_courses_in_county AS (
  SELECT 
    p.id,
    p.poi_name,
    p.addr_city,
    p.addr_state,
    p.geometry
  FROM pois p
  JOIN regions r
    ON ST_Intersects(p.geometry::geometry, r.geometry::geometry)
  WHERE p.poi_name ILIKE '%golf%'
    AND p.addr_state = 'MN'
    AND r.region_name = 'Hennepin County'
    AND r.border_type = 'county'
),
slope_analysis AS (
  SELECT
    gc.id,
    gc.poi_name,
    gc.addr_city,
    gc.addr_state,
    ST_Slope(
      ST_Clip(public.dem_us.rast, gc.geometry::geometry),
      1
    ) AS slope_rast
  FROM golf_courses_in_county gc
  JOIN public.dem_us
    ON ST_Intersects(public.dem_us.rast, gc.geometry::geometry)
),
slope_stats AS (
  SELECT
    id,
    poi_name,
    addr_city,
    addr_state,
    ST_Statistics(slope_rast, 1).mean AS mean_slope
  FROM slope_analysis
)
SELECT *
FROM slope_stats
ORDER BY mean_slope DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
